title: "Luxury Resort 1 Mile from the Grand ole Opry"
description: At Club Wyndham Nashville, enjoy convenient access to Music City, Broadway and local sporting events. Children will enjoy table tennis and basketball. What’s a resort vacation without swimming? There are both indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, plus a fully equipped fitness center. When it’s time to relax, guests are welcome to borrow a DVD from the resort library and take it back to their condo suite. All this and more is part of the philosophy of southern hospitality at Club Wyndham Nashville.
